Ethiopia's Tigray Region Faces Internet, Phone Disruptions Amid Renewed Fighting

Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military has cited major losses by rebels amid the escalating clashes, which are widening across the region.
